title: Abraham Lincoln: A Play
summary: "Abraham Lincoln: A Play by John Drinkwater" is a play written in 1918 about the 16th President of the United States. This British playwright's first major success chronicles Lincoln's presidency from his 1860 election to his assassination, focusing on his public life while omitting most private events. The play became a sensation in London and ran for 193 performances on Broadway in 1919.
